20447:
**ἐπί-στασις**, -εως, ἡ 
(ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:3 * ;] 
1. **a stopping**, **halting** (as of soldiers): ὄχλου, **collecting a crowd** (see Rack-ham, _Acts_, l.with): [[44-acts.24.12|Act.24:12]] (WH, Rec. ἐπισύστασις). 
2. **superintendence**, **attention** (but see Thayer, see word; Field, _Notes_, 185 f.): [[47-2-corinthians.11.28|2Co.11:28]] (WH, Rec. ut supr.).
(AS)
